subject: Aids to Navigation - Northern Grand Banks
text:
Aids to Navigation - Northern Grand Banks
Two-legged ODAS mooring deployed. 
The first anchor position is 46 42.511N, 048 51.444W and is marked with a yellow spherical wave buoy with a yellow navigational light with flash pattern 5 flashes every 20 seconds.
The second anchor position is 46 42.395N, 048 51.666W and is marked with a red high flyer buoy with a yellow navigational light with flash pattern 5 flashes every 20 seconds and radar reflector.
Caution
